text:
Noah: Heads up — VerdantSys paused the POC. Procurement says no PO until we're in their vendor portal and the contract includes EU data residency + a customer-managed KMS option.
Evelyn: Are they insisting KMS before pilot start or can it be a milestone?
Marcus: Security emailed: "KMS must be available for audit logs during the pilot" — they marked it as a blocker.
Leah: From engineering: we can enable EU-only hosting quickly for Dedicated/Private. BYO-KMS for logs is not supported for hosted; estimate 10 business days to build a minimal export pipeline.
Noah: Commercial asks for a flat pilot fee instead of usage billing. Finance/Billing needs signoff.
CFO-Bot: Recommended pilot flat fee: $9,500 for 30 days. CRO approval required for exceptions.
Evelyn: Legal can accept vendor portal flow but won't commit to KMS in contract unless eng confirms feasibility and ETA.
Marcus: I'll put together a tech note with risks and mitigation and assign a ticket. eng-oncall: ticket TKT-6191 created for BYO-KMS feasibility (assignee: Marcus).
Leah: If customer accepts conditional commitment (KMS delivered within 14 days), we can start the pilot with reduced logging.
Noah: Action items: 1) Leah: ETA + risk by EOD; 2) Marcus: tech note + ticket; 3) Evelyn: legal redline w/ conditional KMS clause; 4) Noah: schedule exec-to-exec call (include CRO & Head of Legal). I'll update Verdant contact after exec sync.
Evelyn: Scheduling now — proposed slots tomorrow 10:30am CET or Friday 2pm PST.
Noah: Thanks all — please flag any other blockers here. :thumbsup:
